tasks.title: Directed weighted paths
tasks.problem_statement: Read n m s, then m lines u v w. Vertices are numbered 0 through n-1. Print the minimum total weight from s to each vertex in order, using -1 for unreachable vertices. Edges are directed and parallel edges and zero weights are allowed. 1 <= n <= 200000; 0 <= m <= 300000; 0 <= w <= 1000000000. Use 64-bit distances. Select an efficient algorithm; no particular technique is required.

tasks.title: Unlimited denominations
tasks.problem_statement: Read n target, followed by n positive coin denominations. Print the minimum number of coins needed to sum exactly to target, or -1 if impossible. Each denomination can be used any number of times. 1 <= n <= 100; 0 <= target <= 100000; coin values are at most 100000. Duplicate denominations are permitted. The task does not require a particular algorithm.

tasks.title: Profitable intervals
tasks.problem_statement: Read n, then n lines start end profit describing half-open time intervals [start,end). Select mutually nonoverlapping intervals with maximum total profit. Print that profit. Adjacent intervals may both be selected; choosing none is allowed. 0 <= n <= 200000; 0 <= start < end <= 1000000000; 0 <= profit <= 1000000000. Use 64-bit totals. No algorithm is prescribed.

tasks.title: Maximum rectangle sum
tasks.problem_statement: Read rows columns, followed by a rectangular integer matrix. Print the largest sum of any nonempty rectangle of consecutive rows and columns. 1 <= rows, columns <= 200; values lie between -1000000000 and 1000000000. Use a 64-bit sum. All-negative matrices must select at least one cell. Choose the algorithm yourself.

tasks.title: Paths in an acyclic graph
tasks.problem_statement: Read n m followed by m directed edges u v with vertices 0 through n-1. The graph is acyclic. Print the number of distinct paths from vertex 0 to vertex n-1, modulo 1000000007. Parallel edges represent distinct choices. With n=1 the empty path counts once. 1 <= n <= 200000; m <= 300000. Vertex labels need not be in topological order. No specific algorithm is required.

tasks.title: Inclusive range additions
tasks.problem_statement: Read n q, followed by q lines left right delta. Begin with n zeros and add delta to each index in the inclusive range [left,right] for every operation. Print the final n values separated by spaces. Indices start at zero; 1 <= n <= 200000; 0 <= q <= 200000; -1000000000 <= delta <= 1000000000. Use 64-bit results. Any efficient technique is allowed.
